value.rationale: The natural strict partial-matching deletion family reveals a rigid odd-block decomposition and exact named-color polynomial for every palette. The optimum has sharp parity jumps t+epsilon(m)+epsilon(r), while the number of minimum partitions is exponentially large when unmatched sides are even. This solves a meaningful family-level enumeration beyond known scalar endpoint results.
